title: Understanding Silhouette Scores
text: A silhouette score measures how similar a data point is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. If a point has a negative silhouette score, it means it's closer to points in a different cluster than to points in its own cluster. Think about what this implies for the point's placement.

title: Evaluating Silhouette Scores
